p5buyer.title: Products from India
p5buyer.intro: Look through products from suppliers that MITRA has reviewed. Ask for a price when you find something you like.

card.priceDateMissing: The supplier has not given a price date.
card.availabilityDateMissing: The supplier has not given a date for this statement.

tiers.caption: Indicative unit price by quantity ({currency})
tiers.captionVariant: Option {variant}: indicative unit price by quantity ({currency})

search.label: Search products
search.qHint: A product name, a product code or a supplier name.
search.moqMax: Largest minimum order you can accept
search.moqMaxHint: Shows products that can be ordered in this quantity or fewer.
search.priceHint: Choose a currency first. Prices are shown in the currency the supplier used and are not converted.
search.needCurrency: Please choose a currency to filter by price. The price filter was not used.
search.errorTitle: We could not load the products
search.errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you typed was lost. Please try again in a moment.
search.pageEmptyTitle: There is nothing on this page
search.noneBody: Here are some things to try:
search.tipFewerFilters: Use fewer filters, or a wider category.
search.tipOtherWords: Try other words, or a shorter search.
search.tipPrice: Widen the price range or the minimum order.
search.emptyCatalogueTitle: There are no products here yet
search.emptyCatalogueBody: Suppliers are still being added. Please check again soon.

compare.title: Compare products
compare.full: You can compare up to {max} products. Remove one first.
compare.needTwo: Choose at least two products to compare.
compare.emptyBody: Tick Compare on two to four products in the list, then come back here.
compare.allGone: These products are not shown any more, so they cannot be compared.
compare.someGone: {n} of the products are not shown any more and were left out.
compare.errorTitle: We could not load the comparison
compare.errorBody: Please try again in a moment.
compare.mixedCurrencies: These products use different currencies ({currencies}). Prices are shown as given by each supplier. They are not converted and not ranked against each other.
compare.note: Only what the suppliers gave is compared. Where nothing was given, it says Not provided.
compare.tableRegion: Comparison table, scroll sideways to see more
compare.outdated: Old statement: please ask the supplier side.

detail.noImages: The supplier has not added photos yet.
detail.notQuotation: This is an indicative price set by the supplier. It is not a quotation or an offer. Ask for a price to get one for your quantity.
detail.tiersIntro: Prices are in {currency}, as given by the supplier. Indicative, not a quotation.
detail.fixedPriceNote: The supplier gave one price for every quantity. Indicative, not a quotation.
detail.noConversion: Prices are never converted between currencies. They are shown in the currency the supplier used.
detail.moreFromSupplier: See more products from this supplier

report.title: Report this product
report.signIn: Sign in to report a product
report.sent: Thank you. MITRA will look at your report.

request.title: Request a price
request.intro: Tell the supplier side what you need. This asks for a price. It is not an order, and you do not have to buy.
request.variantHint: Optional. Choose one if you already know which option you want.
request.quantityHint: Whole numbers only. The minimum order is {moq} {unit}.
request.neededByHint: Use a date that has not passed.
request.notesHint: For example colours, sizes, packing, or questions about the product. Up to 1000 characters.
request.privacy: Your organisation name, these details and your message are shared with the partner who looks after this supplier. Please do not write bank or card numbers.
request.sessionNote: If you are signed out while writing, your words stay on this page.
request.signInAgain: Sign in again in a new tab
request.belowMoq: The quantity is below the minimum order of {moq}. Please enter {moq} or more.
request.notAccepting: This supplier is not accepting requests right now, or this product is no longer shown. Your request was not sent.

saved.title: Saved products
saved.intro: Products you saved. If a product is no longer shown, it stays here and says so.
saved.error: We could not load your saved products. Please try again.
saved.emptyTitle: You have not saved any products
saved.emptyBody: Choose Save product on a product you want to come back to.
saved.unavailableBody: This product is not shown at the moment. It may have been withdrawn or paused. You can remove it from your list.

requests.title: My product requests
requests.intro: Price requests you sent for products from India. They stay here every time you sign in.
requests.error: We could not load your requests. Please try again.
requests.emptyTitle: You have not sent any product requests
requests.emptyBody: Find a product and choose Request Price. Your requests will appear here.
requests.sentBody: Your reference is {reference}. Keep it for any question. You can follow what happens next on this page.
requests.snapshotNote: These are the terms as they were shown when you sent the request. Later changes by the supplier do not change this record.
requests.noLongerShown: This product is not shown any more

statusHelp.submitted: Your request was sent and is waiting for the supplier side.
statusHelp.acknowledged: The supplier side has received your request.
statusHelp.clarification_requested: The supplier side asked you a question. Please reply below.

requests.withdrawBody: The supplier side will see that you withdrew it. You can send a new request later.

notFound.title: We cannot show this product
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the product is not shown at the moment. Try searching for it again.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: We could not show this page. Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back a little later.
